description: This file defines models and methods related to analytic user functions, including a relation table between users and products on analytic accounts, extensions to analytic accounts and timesheets, and recursive logic for user-account relations.

classes.name: analytic_user_funct_grid
classes.description: Relation table between users and products on an analytic account

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Extension of analytic account to include user-product relations

classes.name: hr_analytic_timesheet
classes.description: Extension of timesheet with recursive user-account relation logic and on-change handlers

methods.name: _get_related_user_account_recursiv
methods.description: Recursively searches for user-analytic account relation, traversing parent accounts if necessary

methods.name: on_change_account_id
methods.description: Handles changes to account_id, updating related product and account info based on user-account relation

methods.name: on_change_user_id
methods.description: Handles changes to user_id, updating related product and account info based on user-account relation
